FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 22
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/20/2023
House Bill 22 as introduced would allow municipalities or governmental entities subject to a
countywide civil service system to opt out of such system under certain conditions. This bill will
not otherwise directly affect state or local funding.
